description: This line plot illustrates the average performance of three evaluation metrics across varying model sizes. The x-axis, which lacks a specific title, employs a logarithmic scale ranging from 70m to 7.0B, with tick labels specifically marked at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is labeled "Avg. Performance (%)" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from 0 to 80, featuring tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot contains three solid lines, all utilizing upward-pointing triangle markers. The red line, representing Precision, begins at approximately 78% at 70m, experiences a slight decline to a low of roughly 71% at 410m, and then gradually increases to end at approximately 76% at 7.0B. The blue line, representing Recall, demonstrates a steady upward trend, starting at approximately 8% at 70m and rising continuously to end at roughly 45% at 7.0B. The purple line, representing the F1-score, follows a similar steady upward trajectory, beginning at approximately 14% at 70m and increasing to end at roughly 56% at 7.0B.
